facts.fact: autoStartChunks is 300: most chunks agent-started import job may run without user's consent.
Runner.Run returns ErrRunnerBusy when another runner holds store's lock.
ErrRunnerBusy is supported state, not failure.
In RunnerOptions, only Agent required.
Runner schedules bulk imports through stages scan, materialise, extract, finalize.
Exactly one Runner runs per memory.db, enforced by exclusive flock.
Runner follows job rows control side (Engine) writes, by polling.
Pause or cancel from another process takes effect within one tick.
All Runner state lives in memory.db.
Halted runner resumes from disk.
NewRunner takes no lock.
Run takes store's runner lock, works until ctx ends or store idle for IdleExit.
Runner taking lock resets what crashed predecessor left mid-flight.
On lock take, running jobs become paused; scanning jobs rescan.
Runner never resumes a job by itself.
Runner.tryExit releases lock, then looks once more for work a control call wrote meanwhile.
facts.reason: Stated in runner.go.txt, because a job set running just before lock release would otherwise find no runner

facts.fact: Runner.tryExit reports done when runner should end; otherwise returns with lock taken again.
Runner.shutdown stops all work and waits for it.
With recover, Runner.shutdown ends running jobs paused as interrupted and sends in-flight chunks back to pending.
Idle exit has nothing to recover.
Runner.spawn runs fn on goroutine runner waits for and counts as in flight.
Runner.arm gives job the context its in-flight calls run under.
Pause, cancel and finish disarm job context, killing its in-flight calls.
Runner.sync reads job states written by control side.
Runner.sync gives running jobs a context; jobs that left running lose theirs, killing their calls.
Runner.sync gives scanning jobs a scan and settles finished jobs.
Runner.sync reports whether any job is scanning or running.
Runner.plan turns scan into file rows.
Runner.plan skips duplicates and already imported content, with reason.
Runner.plan chunks remaining files once to size job.
Runner.schedule starts as much work as slots allow.
Runner.schedule orders work: extract workers for pending chunks, cross-check workers, reading and chunking next file, then single finalize worker.
Runner.startSlotWork spends extract slot caller holds.
Runner.startSlotWork reports whether more work may follow; slot released when it returns false or starts nothing.
Runner.materialiseNext reads, validates, hashes, chunks next pending file.
Runner.materialiseNext reports whether it changed anything, so scheduler asks again.
Runner.settle finishes job whose files are all terminal.
Runner.retry runs op with exponential backoff.
Runner.retry stops at once on fatal errors, spent budget, or cancelled context.
Rate limit also holds every other worker back until its wait is over.
Runner.runVerify cross-checks file's questionable facts against copy of its source, one batch at a time.
Runner.runVerify saves each batch's verdicts before next batch, so interrupted run keeps them.
tooManyFacts guards step-2 prompt size.
File over tooManyFacts limit fails instead of being truncated.
